quotes.text: `CalendarEventCreateEditDialog` appends its template directly to the dialog and has no shadow root; bare `<slot>` elements in that template cannot distribute consumer children. Remove the slots and add dialog-owned header rows directly in light DOM. Nested reusable controls can still use shadow DOM when it provides a useful boundary. [Task 1]
